title: Four Children Posing on Rocks in Woods, 1940s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century outdoor snapshot depicting four siblings posing among large sunlit boulders in a dense wooded area. Two older boys in white collared shirts stand proudly in the background, while a younger girl sits on a rock in the foreground cradling an infant on her lap. Light flares streak across the left and right edges, characteristic of vintage camera optics or developing light leaks. The back of the photograph shows black album mount residue and a stamped processing number.
